maria-s: Quick sync — Everest POC (enterprise trial). Need confirmation on network whitelist IPs + final CR for the SE connector. We promised a dry-run next Tue, so owners: can you confirm blockers and ETA? cc @devin-infra @jules-eng @anya-ps

devin-infra: I can raise the whitelist request today but need the exact IP list + port ranges. Also will need the staging cert thumbprint. ETA: will post PR ticket by EOD.

jules-eng: Connector PR is open: #482. I've addressed most comments but tests are failing on the quantized run (local CI). 

sam-infra: I'll take the review. Can you paste the failing test snippet? also we need a k8s service account for the staging job so I can bind network policies.

jules-eng: failing log clip:
```
E 11:12:34 quantize_test.cpp:172 - mismatch: kv-cache size 0 vs expected 1024
Trace: stack at quantize_run->optimize_kv()
```
I'll re-run with extra logging and push a fix later today.

anya-ps: From CS side — client expects dry-run Tuesday (11/25) at 14:00 PST. They asked for an acceptance checklist: network whitelist, sample payloads, auth key rotation doc, and a failsafe rollback. We should confirm token budget — I proposed 2.5M tokens for the run, is that ok?

devin-infra: 2.5M tokens looks fine for staging. For whitelist: add these CIDRs: 34.210.12.0/24, 52.23.45.128/26. Ports: 443 outbound, 5222 for websocket fallback. Will send formal request to infra-ops.

maria-s: Perfect — @sam-infra and @jules-eng can we confirm code review + infra bindings by EOD tomorrow so CS can lock the dry-run? Also need owner for the rollback runbook.

sam-infra: I'll own the runbook and the service account binding. Plan: create runbook PR in repo infra/runbooks/everest -- ETA tomorrow morning.

jules-eng: If my fix passes CI I can merge and tag a canary build. Plan: merge -> upload canary image -> smoke test -> handoff. ETA: merge by 11/21 noon PT.

maria-s: Nice. Small note: staging cluster maintenance window is scheduled 11/20 02:00-03:00 UTC per deploy-bot. Make sure the dry-run isn't scheduled during maintenance.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging cluster maintenance 2025-11-20 02:00-03:00 UTC — non-disruptive but pods may restart.

anya-ps: Good catch. We'll keep dry-run on 11/25. Also @jules-eng please attach smoke test checklist to the PR so CS can preview.

jules-eng: Will do. Smoke tests will include: 1) auth handshake, 2) sample 2k token generation, 3) KV cache integrity check.

maria-s: Thanks all — summary: devin -> formal whitelist ticket today; sam -> runbook + k8s SA tomorrow; jules -> fix + CR merge by 11/21; anya -> client dry-run set for 11/25 14:00 PST. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup:

sam-infra: :thumbsup:

jules-eng: will ping when PR is green.

maria-s: tagging follow-up action items in Asana after this thread.
